primary_sources.inspection_note: Read the original versioned paper text. Independent experts and sparse weighted sums support the introduction. The paper uses noisy top-k with normalization over selected experts and describes k>1 task-gradient routing; it is not the identical implementation as this repository. Performance discussion explicitly identifies shrinking batches and bandwidth costs. No paper benchmark has been reproduced here, and no paper figure is claimed visually inspected.

primary_sources.inspection_note: Read versioned original. Equation (2) retains the selected softmax gate for top-1, explaining a task-gradient path; equations (4)-(6) support the load/probability auxiliary term. The repository top-2 convention is separately normalized and its dropless loop differs from Switch capacity-limited routing. Only the introduction concepts and code-navigation promise are certified; paper quality/speed numbers are not imported into the verdict. No paper figure is claimed visually inspected.
